title: Simon 3.2, injective regular case: area formula for an injective map with injective derivative on a Borel set
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ and ℝᵈ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d). Let s ⊆ ℝⁿ be a Borel set and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ a map such that Φ is differentiable at every x ∈ s, the derivative DΦ(x) is injective for every x ∈ s, and Φ is injective on s. Then μHE[n](Φ(s)) = ∫⁻_{x∈s} ofReal(areaJacobian(DΦ(x))) dμHE[n](x). Here areaJacobian(L) = √det(L* ∘ L) is the contract's definition. μHE[n] is Mathlib's n-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff measure: on ℝᴺ for the image, and on ℝⁿ, where it equals Lebesgue measure, for the integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (s : Set (Rn n)) (Φ : Rn n → Rn N), MeasurableSet s → (∀ x ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x) → (∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → InjOn Φ s → μHE[n] (Φ '' s) = ∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (areaJacobian (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) ∂μHE[n]
